Blocks.Text: After completing your Apply Connect integration, use these steps to migrate customers from the Easy Apply APIs:

Submit a list of customer LinkedIn Developer Application IDs to LinkedIn for Apply Connect allowlisting.
Wait for LinkedIn to confirm allowlisting, then sync all customer public, external job postings to LinkedIn.
Update all job postings with relevant application questions (OnsiteApplicationConfigurations) for default opt-in customers of LinkedIn Easy Apply.
Communicate with opt-in customers on how to enable the new integration.
